theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.title: 01.AI's Kai-Fu Lee on Pacing Frontier AI Development
top_news.summary: Kai-Fu Lee, CEO of 01.AI, says he suspects American AI companies may already have developed models that are "really great, but also really scary." He discusses this on "Bloomberg: The China Show" on the sidelines of the BNP Paribas Global Markets APAC Conference. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Macerich CEO: Consumers Are Spending, but Are Selective
top_news.summary: Macerich's President and CEO, Jack Hsieh, joins the program shortly after presenting at the Bank of America real estate conference. The segment is framed around Macerich and the broader theme of "tracking the shopping mall resurgence." He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: DoubleLine’s Gundlach Warns of Fiscal Crisis in Next Recession
top_news.summary: DoubleLine Capital chief executive Jeffrey Gundlach warned that the next US downturn could trigger a debt crisis that sends long-term Treasury yields sharply higher — defying decades of conventional wisdom that bonds will always serve as safe haven during times of economic strife.

top_news.title: US to Sell F-35s to Saudi Arabia in $24.3 Billion Deal
top_news.summary: The State Department notified Congress that it plans to sell Saudi Arabia up to 48 F-35 warplanes in a first-time sale that could be worth as much as $24.3 billion. The sale of the Lockheed Martin Corp. fighter jet to Saudi Arabia has been in the works for a number of years. President Donald Trump signaled in November the US would sell F-35s to the Kingdom, offering Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman a prize he’s long cherished, ahead of a visit to the White House that month. top_news.title: Saudi Pivots Oil Routes After Pipeline Attack
top_news.summary: Saudi Arabia is ramping up prompt sales of crude from outside the Strait of Hormuz following the shutdown of the kingdom’s East-West pipeline, which halted cross-country flows to its Red Sea coast. The sale helped attribute to a fall in oil prices as physical markets cooled from recent peaks as traders bet some Middle East supply outages would be short-lived. top_news.title: Gold Surges Along With US Treasuries as Oil Price Slide Deepens
top_news.summary: Gold rallied alongside Treasuries as a slump in oil prices helped ease concerns about inflation, following the Federal Reserve’s first interest-rate hike since 2023.

top_news.title: Stocks, Bonds Rise After Fed-Day Drop as Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks joined bonds higher as falling oil prices lent support to optimism that inflation can be kept under control a day after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023.

top_news.title: Oil Drops as Traders See Supply Outages Proving Short-Lived
top_news.summary: Oil fell as physical markets cooled from recent peaks as traders bet some Middle East supply outages would be short-lived.

top_news.title: Suspended Glencore Executive Told Radiant ‘Say Nothing on Email’
top_news.summary: A senior Glencore Plc executive last year urged counterparts at Radiant World not to communicate by email, according to WhatsApp messages from the company’s head of iron ore seen by Bloomberg News.

top_news.title: Small Town America Confronts Data Centers, Rejects Some Plans
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Shruti Singh joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Blackstone-owned QTS proposed a massive data center in Clinton, Iowa, that would bring thousands of construction jobs and provide nearly $200 million in property taxes in its first 10 years.
